name: IRAPH SUI
insider_take: Perched on the coral-fringed cliffs of Miyako-jima, IRAPH SUI channels the soul of the Ryukyu Islands — where cerulean waters meet minimalist luxury in one of Japan's most breathtaking island escapes.
whats_special: Clifftop Infinity Pool: The resort's stunning infinity pool appears to pour directly into the East China Sea — one of the most dramatic pool settings in all of Japan. Name Rooted in Legend: "IRAPH SUI" draws from local Miyako dialect — iraph meaning "beautiful" and sui meaning "water" — a fitting tribute to this island paradise. World-Class Diving at Your Doorstep: Miyako-jima is renowned for its ultra-clear waters with visibility exceeding 50 meters, making it a top destination for divers seeking vibrant coral reefs and sea turtles. Ryukyuan Culture Woven In: The design and culinary offerings pay deep homage to the distinct Ryukyu Kingdom heritage — separate from mainland Japanese culture — reflected in local textiles, cuisine, and traditions.
pro_tip: Book a room with an ocean-facing terrace and set your alarm early — Miyako-jima sunrises over the East China Sea are utterly unforgettable and best enjoyed with the resort's curated morning tea service.
dont_miss: Yonaha Maehama Beach: Just minutes away, this consistently ranks as one of Japan's most beautiful beaches — with white powder sand stretching nearly 7 kilometers. Local Awamori Tasting: Okinawa's signature spirit, distilled from Thai rice, has been crafted on these islands for over 600 years. Ask the concierge for a curated local tasting experience. Irabu Bridge: The longest toll-free bridge in Japan (3.5 km) connects Miyako-jima to the neighboring island of Irabu — a scenic drive not to be missed.
pros: Exclusive luxury resort in pristine Miyako Jima setting
Premium beachfront location with crystal-clear waters
Authentic Okinawan cultural experiences and cuisine
Marriott STARS Program exclusive benefits and amenities
cons: Remote island location requires connecting flights
Limited dining and entertainment options in surrounding area
